sources.locator: "Afghan Civil War (1992–1996)", revision 1371836551, § lead and § Background — 1989–1992 civil war

explanation: The English article on the 1992–1996 war opens by placing it directly on the end of the one before it: "The war immediately followed the 1989–1992 civil war with the Mujahideen victory and dissolution of the Republic of Afghanistan in April 1992." It is the collapse of Najibullah’s republic — the outcome of the earlier war — that left the question of who would govern for the factions to fight over.
